name: CONTENT FLYWHEEL
purpose: Derive content from the engineering system instead of inventing posts, keeping generation downstream from verified engineering evidence.
template: Source chain: MISSION -> CHANGE -> TEST -> FAILURE -> FIX -> EVIDENCE -> CONTENT CANDIDATE. Generation is downstream from verified evidence; nothing is generated from a plan or an idea. Each candidate carries its evidence into whichever outputs it earns: short technical post, deep dive, diagram, benchmark, failure postmortem, architecture note, demo, release note. Rule: if the evidence is not verified, there is no candidate. The flywheel never invents posts to fill a calendar.
